name: ss-status
description: SpecSwarm status line: a rich Claude Code statusline (directory, git, model, context, rate limits, session usage) plus a real-time background-builder segment for SpecSwarm conduct dispatches — answers 'is it safe to close / shut down?' at a glance, no daemon needed. Wraps your existing statusline if you have one. One-time /ss-status:install, then zero commands.
